description: Example Amicus medicine record for Galafold (migalastat), Amicus's first-and-only oral therapy for adults with Fabry disease who have an amenable GLA variant.

medicine.patientPopulation: Adults with Fabry disease who have a GLA gene variant that is responsive (amenable) to Galafold
medicine.mechanismOfAction: Selective, reversible binding to amenable mutant forms of alpha-galactosidase A to stabilize the enzyme, facilitate lysosomal trafficking, and restore activity
